items.title: BRAC Bank rolls out unified banking service
items.description: BRAC Bank PLC yesterday launched a unified banking service that allows customers to access services according to their individual needs.

items.title: Pubali Bank turns Gulshan branch into Islamic banking outlet
items.description: Pubali Bank PLC has converted its Gulshan Circle-1 Branch into an Islamic banking branch to expand its shariah-compliant services.

items.title: Trust Bank launches deposit account for NRBs
items.description: Trust Bank PLC has launched a deposit account for non-resident Bangladeshis (NRBs), allowing them to save, manage and invest their overseas earnings in the country.

items.title: Aramco takes 49% stake in Saudi AI company
items.description: Oil major Saudi Aramco said it was taking a 49 percent stake in state-backed AI company Humain on Sunday, injecting cash and assets as the tech firm tries to scale up to meet rising demand.
